description:
The order test (canon_test ORDER_FREE_PLANS) compares each listed fixture's backend plan under fifo and lifo job order only. Some splits show only under other orders: under JSON's seeded pop order, 01353 gives 2 plans under seeds 3 and 5, while fifo and lifo agree (recorded on fz-t93.29). t3 splits under lifo and seed 3.

Change (test-only, nothing in shipped builds, no environment variable):
- fz_engine::pop_order gains PopOrder::Seeded(u64), backed by a small xorshift generator. JSON's ready diff: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/ebbfffd8-2561-4da7-bcda-f9a316d00a1e/scratchpad/mue25/probes/p9/seeded_only.diff
- The order test runs each listed fixture under fifo, lifo and a fixed set of seeds, and requires one plan.

Verification: a fixture that splits only under a seed fails the extended test on base (01353 is the candidate once fz-t93.29 has fixed it, or a test with a known seeded split).
title: The order test runs every plan under fifo, lifo and seeded orders
